# Findings: RS-02 inventory-tools

## Answer
Tallowmere Stock exports items and counts as a file [F-01] and lists 18 USD per seat per month [F-04]. Marrowby Goods offers no export [F-02]. Brackenfold Inventory's export seems limited to printed reports [F-03], and it lists 22 USD per seat per month [F-05].

## Findings

### F-01
- claim: Tallowmere Stock exports every item and its stock count as a CSV file at any time.
- level: HIGH
- basis: states
- sources: S-01 (inbox/tallowmere-export-help.html, retrieved 2026-10-18, primary)
- conflicts: none
- watch: no
- run: R-1
